name: catalog-resize
description: Resizable catalog: a col-resize handle on the docked catalog's right edge widens/narrows it (--catalog-w drives --left-rail so the canvas reflows). Desktop only.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); localStorage.removeItem('hdb_catalog_width') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13)

steps.name: wait-handle
steps.failMessage: resize handle not rendered on desktop

steps.name: assert-wider
steps.eval: (()=>{const w=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--catalog-w').trim();if(w!=='520px')throw new Error('expected --catalog-w=520px, got '+w);const rail=getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.app-shell')).getPropertyValue('--left-rail').trim();if(rail!=='520px')throw new Error('left-rail did not follow catalog width, got '+rail);if(localStorage.getItem('hdb_catalog_width')!=='520')throw new Error('width not persisted')})()
